description: Hi, I'm John Wells, lifelong Missourian. I love this state. Missouri is home to the best sports teams, great universities and beautiful landscapes. We have the benefit of being centrally located, on the Missouri and Mississippi Rivers, with seven distinct geographical regions in our state. I'm a little biased, but I'm especially fond of our great floating rivers and streams in the southern region.
